_readme: ALL CLIPS ARE SYNTHETIC: macOS `say` text-to-speech voices, mixed by backend/scripts/make_clips.py. No real people, no real recordings. Times are seconds from clip start. Paths relative to eval/clips/. Wavs are gitignored; regenerate with `cd backend && uv run python scripts/make_clips.py`.
